article.title: “Decree” defined.
article.content:
1“Decree” defined.

Order 45, Rule 1
In this Order, unless there is something repugnant in the subject or context, the expression “decree” shall include a final order.

Subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “King-in-Council”.
